evidence_items.excerpt_locator: Annual report page 9, principal business: data-center cooling and Coolinside full-chain liquid-cooling products
evidence_items.evidence_summary: The filing places data-center and computing-equipment cooling inside the company's principal business and lists an end-to-end liquid-cooling portfolio including cold plates, quick connectors, manifolds, CDU, cabinets, coolant, piping, and cooling sources.

evidence_items.excerpt_locator: Annual report pages 15-16, product revenue table
evidence_items.evidence_summary: Machine-room temperature-control products generated about RMB 3.448 billion, or 56.83% of company revenue. Liquid cooling is included in this broader product family but is not separately disclosed, so exact liquid-cooling revenue remains undisclosed.

evidence_items.excerpt_locator: Annual report pages 11-13, AIDC power supply and UPS products
evidence_items.evidence_summary: The filing describes mass-market modular UPS products, a 1.2MW UPS certification, deployed prefabricated power modules, and jointly developed UPS products for high-density data-center scenarios.
Data-center products generated about RMB 2.239 billion, or 27.44% of company revenue. The filing does not disclose UPS-only revenue inside that broader product category.

evidence_items.excerpt_locator: Annual report pages 20-21, data-center power products and customers
evidence_items.evidence_summary: The filing lists air-cooled and immersion-cooled CRPS power supplies, customized GPU power supplies, and centralized power systems, and reports shipments or cooperation with major server-system and cloud customers.

evidence_items.excerpt_locator: Annual report pages 20 and 22-23, data-center power revenue
evidence_items.evidence_summary: Data-center power revenue was about RMB 2.015 billion, representing 45.17% of company revenue; high-power data-center power revenue was about RMB 1.299 billion within that segment.

evidence_items.excerpt_locator: Annual report pages 11-12, AIDC key power and HVDC systems
evidence_items.evidence_summary: The filing describes 240V, 336V, and 800V HVDC systems, states that the products have been scaled in cloud, intelligent-computing, and colocation data centers, and presents an end-to-end data-center power product matrix.

evidence_items.excerpt_locator: Annual report page 25, product revenue composition
evidence_items.evidence_summary: Data-center power revenue was about RMB 775.8 million, representing 36.30% of company revenue. The filing does not split HVDC-only revenue from the broader data-center power category.

evidence_items.excerpt_locator: Annual report principal-business section, data-service cooling products and customer disclosure
evidence_items.evidence_summary: The filing identifies evaporative cooling, phase-change cooling, and liquid-cooling products for data-service customers and lists major internet, colocation, server, and cloud-computing customers.

evidence_items.excerpt_locator: Annual report principal-business section, data-service segment discussion
evidence_items.evidence_summary: The filing treats data services as a reporting business segment and reports 43.77% year-on-year growth for the segment, but does not isolate AI-data-center liquid-cooling revenue.

evidence_items.excerpt_locator: Annual report principal-business section, high-power-density thermal-management products
evidence_items.evidence_summary: The filing states that thermal-management products have expanded into information and communications and high-power-density equipment, including cooling products used in data-center-related scenarios.

evidence_items.excerpt_locator: Annual report business and product discussion
evidence_items.evidence_summary: Data-center and information-communication cooling are disclosed applications within the company's thermal-management business, but revenue for the AI-data-center subset is not separately disclosed.

evidence_items.excerpt_locator: Annual report management discussion, data-center cooling equipment
evidence_items.evidence_summary: The filing states that the company supplies cold-source equipment and heat-exchange devices to data centers and describes data-center-specific chiller and cooling products.

evidence_items.excerpt_locator: Annual report business outlook and data-center product discussion
evidence_items.evidence_summary: Data-center cooling is an identified growth application inside the broader industrial refrigeration and HVAC business; data-center-only revenue is not separately disclosed.

evidence_items.excerpt_locator: Annual report pages 15 and 24-26, AI compute-center service and infrastructure development
evidence_items.evidence_summary: The filing identifies AI-compute-center operation as the company's core service and describes high-density power, network, liquid-cooling, energy-management, and modular-delivery capabilities.

evidence_items.excerpt_locator: Annual report principal-business and resource-advantage sections
evidence_items.evidence_summary: AI and data-center infrastructure operation is the company's primary business; the filing also identifies land, energy quotas, power capacity, cooling, and operation as core operating resources.

company_mappings.product_or_service: End-to-end data-center liquid-cooling products and delivery, including cold plates, CDU, manifolds, cabinets, coolant, piping, and cooling sources.
company_mappings.relationship_summary: The company directly supplies products covering the liquid-cooling node. The broader machine-room temperature-control segment is material, but liquid-cooling revenue is not separately disclosed.
company_mappings.notes: Research mapping only. It does not imply valuation, recommendation, order visibility, or future revenue growth.

company_mappings.product_or_service: Modular and high-density UPS products, prefabricated power modules, and AIDC power-supply solutions.
company_mappings.relationship_summary: UPS is a directly disclosed product and part of the company's data-center infrastructure offering. Data-center product revenue is disclosed, but UPS-only revenue is not.
company_mappings.notes: Research mapping only. Market-share statements in the filing are not used as independent value-capture proof.

company_mappings.product_or_service: Server power supplies and centralized power systems for general and high-power AI server applications.
company_mappings.relationship_summary: The company directly supplies server-power products and separately discloses data-center power revenue representing 45.17% of company revenue.
company_mappings.notes: Research mapping only. Customer and revenue evidence establish relevance, not future growth or investment merit.

company_mappings.product_or_service: 240V, 336V, and 800V data-center HVDC systems and integrated AIDC power modules.
company_mappings.relationship_summary: The company directly supplies HVDC systems and reports data-center power revenue representing 36.30% of company revenue, while HVDC-only revenue is not separately disclosed.
company_mappings.notes: Research mapping only. Technical deployment evidence does not establish profit-pool leadership or stock attractiveness.

company_mappings.product_or_service: High-efficiency data-center cooling products including evaporative, phase-change, and liquid-cooling systems.
company_mappings.relationship_summary: The company directly supplies cooling products to data-service customers. Segment growth and customer disclosures support relevance, while AI-data-center liquid-cooling revenue remains undisclosed.
company_mappings.notes: Research mapping only. Customer lists and segment growth do not establish future order growth or investment returns.

company_mappings.product_or_service: Thermal-management products for high-power-density and information-communication equipment.
company_mappings.relationship_summary: The company directly supplies thermal-management products applicable to data-center infrastructure, but AI-data-center revenue and customer concentration are not separately disclosed.
company_mappings.notes: Research mapping only. The mapping reflects disclosed products, not a forecast of market share or profit growth.

company_mappings.product_or_service: Data-center cold-source equipment, chillers, heat exchangers, and related cooling systems.
company_mappings.relationship_summary: The company supplies upstream cold-source and heat-exchange equipment used by data centers. The exposure is direct at the equipment layer but data-center-only revenue is undisclosed.
company_mappings.notes: Research mapping only. The company is an adjacent cooling-equipment beneficiary rather than proof of liquid-cooling system leadership.

company_mappings.product_or_service: AI-compute-center development, delivery, energy-efficiency management, and operation services.
company_mappings.relationship_summary: The company is a downstream infrastructure owner/operator whose service economics depend on power access, cooling, delivery, and utilization rather than an equipment-supplier profit pool.
company_mappings.notes: Research mapping only. It is classified as an indirect beneficiary because it consumes and operates the infrastructure rather than supplying the mapped equipment.
